一头牛，能变成多少肉？: How much of a cow ends up as meat?
最贵的脖仁，一头牛有多少？: How much prized neck meat is in one cow?
先猜：一头牛，最后有多少能变成肉？: First, guess: how much of a cow ends up as meat?
在牛身上向右拖刀，切第一刀。: Drag the knife right across the cow for the first cut.
再向右拖一刀：剔骨、去肥油。: Drag again: take out the bone and fat.
拖不动？点这里切一刀: Can’t drag? Tap here to cut
一头由 600 个方块拼成的牛，每块 1 公斤。向右拖刀，把它分开。: A cow made of 600 blocks, one kilogram each. Drag the knife right to take it apart.
剩下的红块就是肉。左下是第一刀拿走的，右下是第二刀拿走的。: The red blocks left behind are the meat. Bottom left is the first cut; bottom right is the second.
一头牛，不到一半能变成肉。: Less than half of a cow becomes meat.
它不算「肉」：第一刀就和皮、头、内脏一起被拿走了。: It doesn’t count as meat: it left with the hide, head and organs in the first cut.
潮州地方标准 DB4451/T 9—2024。口感秒数不是安全线，吃之前要熟透。: Chaozhou local standard DB4451/T 9—2024. Texture timings are not a safety line; cook meat through before eating.
点牛身上的其他部位看看。: Tap other parts of the cow.
点选牛身上的部位: Choose a part of the cow
第一刀就被拿走的内脏和头: organs and head taken in the first cut
中间一条筋，有嚼劲: a sinew down the middle, chewy
软嫩，肥瘦相间: soft, lean and fat in layers
